key_findings.name: Operating Room Findings
key_findings.interpretation: The scalp was shaved, and then prepped and draped in usual sterile fashion.

procedures.name: Right burr hole craniotomy for evacuation of subdural hematoma and placement of subdural drain

course.narrative: The patient was taken to the operating room and placed in supine position. Following induction of satisfactory general endotracheal anesthesia, the patient was prepared for surgery. Incisions were marked along a putative right frontotemporal craniotomy frontally and over the parietal boss. A bur hole was fashioned with the perforator, which was widened with a 2-mm Kerrison punch. The dura was opened in a cruciate-type fashion, and a subdural drain was inserted under direct vision into the subdural space and brought out through a separate stab incision. The area was closed with interrupted inverted 2-0 Vicryl sutures, and the skin was closed with staples.
